title: 广播规则：从尾维对齐推导 shape
expected_output:
a.shape = (3, 1)
b.shape = (3,)
c.shape = (3, 3)
x.shape = (2, 1, 3)
y.shape = (4, 3)
z.shape = (2, 4, 3)
v + matrix ValueError: operands could not be broadcast together with shap
code:
import numpy as np
a = np.ones((3, 1))
b = np.arange(3)            # shape (3,)
c = a + b
print("a.shape =", a.shape)
print("b.shape =", b.shape)
print("c.shape =", c.shape)        # (3, 3)
x = np.zeros((2, 1, 3))
y = np.ones((4, 3))
z = x + y
print("x.shape =", x.shape)
print("y.shape =", y.shape)
print("z.shape =", z.shape)        # (2, 4, 3)
try:
    np.ones((3,)) + np.ones((3, 4))
    print("v + matrix: OK (unexpected)")
except ValueError as e:
    print("v + matrix ValueError:", str(e)[:50])
